SuperEmbedder -- vendored library source compiled into SuperEmbedderCore

Tag:    v1.0.0
Commit: d326b4214feaec39b756278a684620cb6c6bc34f
Release status: published release v1.0.0 (2026-11-02)
Engine pin (superslm.lock): SuperSLM v1.18.1, commit c3c14b16690a0c0c54de781f6f30380d88e62bd1
Source repository: the upstream SuperEmbedder repository (not this repository)

What is vendored: a library subset of the commit, not the whole distribution. This plugin runs no CMake:
include/, src/, cmake/ (read for reference; the generator reproduces its configure outputs),
CMakeLists.txt (the SEMB_LIBRARY_SOURCES list the wrapper check reads), superslm.lock, the two documents
the library compiles in (docs/certified-builds.json, docs/certification-identity.json; the identity's
bytes feed certification_epoch and so the encoder fingerprint), the W-Q fixtures the library compiles in
(tests/fixtures/wq/: wq-queries.jsonl, wq-truncation-leg.jsonl and their manifest), .gitattributes,
CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, NOTICE, README.md. tests/ (otherwise), tools/, epoch-store/ and docs/ (otherwise)
are not vendored.

Compiled: the 14 SEMB_LIBRARY_SOURCES, the GPU-off adapter (src/superembedder/engine_adapter_gpu_off.cpp;
plugin 1.0 has no GPU path), and src/superembedder/engine_identity/build_identity.cpp, the engine identity
verb, which SuperEmbedder's pin tool normally appends to the engine library. Here the module compiles it
itself, under the rename, with the build record ci/generate_semb_config.py writes. The configure-time
headers CMake would generate are written by that generator into
Source/SuperEmbedderCore/Private/Generated/.

Every file is byte-identical to `git cat-file blob` of the commit's own blob. The repository's own
.gitattributes (`* -text`) is vendored with it, so the bytes are identical on every checkout.
VENDORED_MANIFEST.sha256 records each file's SHA-256 and is checked by
ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py.

Do not hand-edit files under this directory.
